rationale: Reallocate export budget from penultimate tail projections into recurrent-tail value-path preservation: reduce default tail projection FP16 keep from 2 blocks to 1 and add a separate `INT8_FP16_TAIL_V_BLOCKS` budget defaulting to 2. This keeps the current recurrent reverse-tail family intact while testing a compact float-budget shift toward the locally promising recurrent V path under final int8+zlib scoring.
title: Tail Value FP16 Reallocation
